preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, str) and N.isdigit() and 1 <= len(N) <= 18 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case N is a string of digits with length between 1 and 18.
The number of test case strings matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(rank_is_correct(N, int(output_lines[i])) for i, N in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case N, the output line i contains the 1-based rank of N among all permutations of its digits sorted in increasing numerical order.
Every output rank is a positive integer.
